result.title: CellTrack-Bench: Microscopic Cell Tracking Benchmark for Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Large language models have shown outstanding performance on text-first tasks such as coding, math, and writing. Recent efforts are shifting models' training to include scientific problems that often live in highly specialized domains beyond text, such as protein structure and biological images. However, in these scenarios, their general-purpose accuracy compared with specialized algorithms remains in question. One such domain is cell tracking, which requires spatiotemporal awareness of cell dynamics. To evaluate this, we created a new benchmark, CellTrack-Bench, which assesses Vision-Language Models' (VLMs) cell-tracking-related performance against specialized trackers. The full benchmark draws from 15 standard cell-tracking datasets across four imaging modalities and comprises 1,537 problems corresponding to 9,041 cell-linking decisions. We selected a hard subset requiring greater reasoning effort by identifying failures shared across distinct algorithmic trackers. With this proposed dataset, we: (i) evaluated different environment harnesses for VLMs; (ii) benchmarked 9 frontier closed-source models and 13 open-weight models; and (iii) provided a detailed analysis of their failure modes. Code, the stored model outputs, and a pipeline that regenerates the benchmark from the source datasets are available at https://github.com/royerlab/celltrack-bench.

AI.brief_summary: 构建 CellTrack-Bench，从 15 个标准细胞追踪数据集、4 种成像模态中整理出 1537 道题（对应 9041 个细胞链接决策），并筛出不同算法追踪器共同失败的困难子集，评测多种 VLM 与专用追踪器的差距并分析失败模式。
AI.relevance_reason: 细胞链接需跨帧维持实体身份与时空状态，其 VLM 失败模式或可作为核查内部状态是否保留实体关系、证据如何随时间累积的评测线索；但该任务偏向科学图像感知，与 LVR 推理期状态生成的关联需核查。
